en.headline: Government probes repeated signal faults near HKU station after two-day delays
en.dek: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has begun an investigation while officials demand a full report from the MTR on causes and improvements.
body: The government said it is concerned about consecutive signal equipment faults near HKU station that disrupted Island Line services on Wednesday and Thursday mornings, adding five to eight minutes to end-to-end journeys during rush hour.

A government spokesman said the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department had sent staff to the scene and started an investigation. Preliminary findings indicated the incidents did not involve railway safety issues. Officials have required the MTR Corporation to conduct a thorough probe into the causes and to report fully on follow-up work and improvement measures to prevent recurrence.

The MTR Corporation had apologised for the disruptions. On Thursday the fault was repaired by about 8.42am after roughly an hour of slow running; the previous day services took nearly two hours to return to normal. Legislators have urged the operator to check the system comprehensively after the repeated incidents at the same location.

zh.headline: 港大站連兩日信號故障 政府促港鐵徹查機電署展開調查
zh.dek: 機電工程署已派員到場調查，初步顯示不涉鐵路安全，政府要求港鐵全面報告成因及改善措施。
body: 政府表示關注港鐵香港大學站附近連續兩日出現信號設備故障，影響港島綫早高峰服務，總站至總站行車時間需額外5至8分鐘。
政府發言人指，機電工程署已派員前往事故現場了解情況並展開調查，初步顯示不涉及鐵路安全事宜。當局已要求港鐵公司深入調查事故原因，並全面報告跟進工作及改善措施，以防止同類情況再次發生。
港鐵公司曾就延誤致歉。周四故障約於8時42分修復，慢駛約一小時；前日則近兩小時後才恢復正常。立法會議員促請港鐵全面檢查系統，因同一地點接連出現問題。
